summary: Retest of the admin-extras.js fixes (frontend only). Both bugs from iteration 31 are FIXED. Setup: 2 finalized inscriptions for CPF 111.444.777-35 via POST /api/track/registration (course 141 Música Sopros and course 178 Treineiro). /api/admin/inscriptions returned them in this order: 178, then 141. The Inscrições list showed the same order: row 1 .adm-vaga-inline = 'Treineiro', row 2 = the full Música name. The Exibir modal of each row agreed with its row (it uses native data: row 1 Curso = Treineiro, row 2 Curso = Música), so the row-order matching is correct. Modal: E-mail = teste@example.com (not overwritten), the label reads 'Curso' (no 'Cargo Titulo'), and there are no .adm-vaga-inline elements inside the modal. Mapping stayed correct after closing the modals, after 'Atualizar', and when searching by name or by raw CPF. The Cadastro eye button (btn-exibir-cadastro) opens the modal and shows Nome/CPF/E-mail/Último concurso/Inscrições=2/Data. Cleanup done: deleted both test inscriptions plus cadastros 11144477735 and 52998224725 (the latter left over from iteration 31).

ui_bugs.issue: Searching by formatted CPF '111.444.777-35' returns 0 rows. Searching by raw digits '11144477735' or by name works. This is native panel search behavior and probably existed before.

issues: An extra white 👁 button appears in the purple modal header between the name and the close X. It looks like it was injected by mistake (adm-view-btn injected into the modal header?).

action_items: Optional: stop the stray 👁 button from being injected into the Cadastro modal header.
Optional: make the inscriptions search accept a formatted CPF (strip non-digits).

Latent risk: matching assumes the DOM list order equals the /api/admin/inscriptions order for each CPF. If a status filter or pagination hides one of a CPF's inscriptions, the shown row gets inscs[0], which may be the wrong course. Consider matching by protocolo or created_at text, which are already in the row and modal.
critical_code_review_comments: enrichInscriptionRows idx-per-CPF mapping breaks when the visible list is a filtered subset (status filter) or a later page, because the 'seen' counter starts from the first API item for that CPF and not from the visible subset.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted 2 inscriptions plus a cadastro for CPF 11144477735. Also deleted the leftover cadastro 52998224725 from iteration 31.
context_for_next_testing_agent: admin-extras.js?v=q2. Admin login on /donaspainel: the inputs have no type=text, so use locator('input').nth(0/1). Inscrições rows carry data-adm-enriched; the course is in .adm-vaga-inline. The details modal uses .kv-k labels. The Cadastro eye button is [data-testid=btn-exibir-cadastro].
